book.name: EFESO
book.title: Efeso wedi Leta Pol wana Luluweli

content: Nau Pol, Helak wana nuwotu heine a tabwa Keriso Yeisu wana apostol. A leli leta ya ge a patile i lowo Helak wana bobode hebwaden hu miye Efeso heimiu, humiu togoru suwok Keriso Yeisu heine.
Helak Tamade ge wada Guyau Yeisu Keriso gen si muloluyanmiu ge wedi mimalum gen i pasusuwoku hatiyemiu.
Keriso heine Helak Hobak I Giyau Mulolu Bwabwaligane Heide

Ta tobalan Helak, iye wada Guyau Yeisu Keriso wana Helak ge Tamane. I bosowaine suwok ta tobalan, kaiwane Keriso hei hobak i giyau heide mulolu bwabwaligane i hudi he bulubulu yayaluwade wana dohob kaiwane.
Sohode tagi ya. Muyai habe i ginawi panayawi, Keriso heine hobak i haseide wana bobode gen ta bwabwalene ge tab hada pwapwatim i egan he matane.
Sauge veto dedei i nunuwane-yanide, iyete i nuwotu pasuwae te Yeisu Keriso wana kaiwo hei habe i hawa he-nanatune-yanide. Iye totone he wana yariyae ge wana nuwotu te i ginawi sohode ti yake.
Iyete ta tobalan wana mulolu madimadiine kaiwane, mulolu yake hobak i giyo bwage-yan heide he Natune nunuwaneine suwok.
Helak wana mulolu i kai suwok, iyete Keriso wana mate hei Helak hobak i pamaise pahavileide ge i nuwoyok wada gegi.
Helak i ligin nabiyan wana mulolu heide bwaine sibe bwabwaligane ge lapu dodohobine.
Wana nuwotu sumosumoine hobak i payoumate heide, kaiwane i yariyae-yan te Keriso hei i ginawi sohode.
Hana sauge suwok hei benan i ginawi wana nuwotu yake, iye te bwele bigi bwabwaligane he bulubulu ge he panayawi i pipatoyao ge Keriso iye i kaun-an.
Hamai Keriso hei Helak i yomoyai wana bobode, kaiwane sauge veto dedei i nuwotu sohode. (Bigi bwabwaligane Helak i ginawiid sohode iye wana nuwotu.)
Iyete hamai hebwaden ha hotei deiyan Keriso hana med, Helak i yomoyai wana bobode iloke gen ha hosenge Helak hidane ge ha tobalan.

Humiu hedi, hu longe wase tolosuwokine, iye Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine hemi pwamwad kaiwane, iyete hobak hu goru Keriso heine ge hu tabwa wana bobode-yan. Iyete Helak hobak i hotei hetutuhine heimiu sohode bagayeune, iye te Yayaluwo Gagabubine i giyau heimiu sohode wana liwo tuwoi.

Hobak ta ho mwao Yayaluwo Gagabubine, iloke ta lapu dohob bwabwaligane hebwaden Helak i gotei kaiwade benan habe ta howo hedi. Ta matemate hana had Helak i sohe suwokanide ge i yomoide bwaide ta miye. Ta hosenge hidane ge ta tobalan!
Pol I Hawanun Helak heine Efeso kaiwadiye
Hobak a longe lemi goru Guyau Yeisu heine ge lemi nunuwane Helak wana bobode heidiye wasane.
Ga yake kaiwane taine a edemanao gomulolu Helak heine kaiwamiu, ge sauge hoyowate a ehauhawanun kaiwamiu.
A hawanun wada Guyau Yeisu Keriso wana Helak, iye Tamade Towasewase, gen i giyau Yayaluwane heimiu, iloke iye i pasibemiu ge i payoumate Helak heimiu, bwen hana lapu i kai heimiu.

A hawanun Helak gen i pawayae lemi nuwotu, iloke gen hu lapu te iye hobak i gon heimiu ge bosowaine bwaimiu lemi hatamatuwo hu mimihuvave wasewase lahine gane Helak habe i giyau hide wana bobode heide.
Sohode hedi gen hu lapu Helak wana gaisi i kai suwok mwage i kaikaiwo hide togoru-yan heide. Gaisiine hotaege hei te
Helak i pasuwoyukim Keriso he mate ge i hotei i tuwodau he nimane wana hinone he bulubulu.

Iyete Keriso iye i kai lakeid todedei bwabwaligadiye, gaisi denan bwabwaligadiye, anelose-yan bwabwaligadiye, tologugui bwabwaligadiye, ge ide bwabwaligane hebwaden si gan sauge ya ge hebwaden habe si gan sauge eluwom.
Helak i hotei Keriso i logugui-yanid bigi bwabwaligadiye si miye he hehene gabulane, ge i hotei i kaunan ekelesiya hana duwohe bwabwaligane.
Ekelesiya iye Keriso tuwane, ge Keriso iye i pabwasowo ekelesiya ge i pasusuwoku hana dohob bwabwaligane.
